input.name: styling
input.label: Styling
input.help-text: Default styling ships the app's own CSS. Choose No styling to leave the markup unstyled and handle it in the site's own stylesheet. Colors chosen by editors are inline and apply either way.

item-set.name: colors
item-set.label: Table colors
item-set.help-text: Colors editors can choose for table rows and cells. Black, White and Transparent are always available.

input.name: key
input.label: Key
input.help-text: Stable identifier stored on the table content. Changing it orphans existing choices. The keys black, white and transparent are reserved.

input.name: label
input.label: Label
input.help-text: Name shown to editors in the color selector.

input.name: background
input.label: Background color
input.help-text: Optional hex value, for example #373b49 or #373b4980 with opacity

input.name: text
input.label: Text color
input.help-text: Optional hex value, for example #f5f5f5 or #f5f5f580 with opacity
